Looking at the folded packet: the top edge is the second-fold crease (horizontal) and the left edge is the first-fold crease (vertical).

- The **blue triangle** is cut into the horizontal crease (top). Unfolding across that crease joins two triangles base-to-base, making a **vertically elongated diamond** on the horizontal midline; the first fold duplicates it to the opposite side. So tall diamonds appear at the **left and right** centers.
- The **red triangle** is cut into the vertical crease (left). Unfolding across that crease makes a **horizontally elongated diamond** on the vertical midline; the second fold duplicates it. So wide diamonds appear at the **top and bottom** centers.

This gives four holes: wide diamonds at top and bottom, tall diamonds at left and right — exactly the pattern in diagram C.

\boxed{C}
